candidates.statement: Checkout 502s (~2s) stem from gateway->order calls timing out: traces show POST order transport ReadTimeout and POST payment ReadTimeout, while inventory/redis succeed. Order's own /v1/orders p95 is 2387.5ms and it returns 502s, indicating order-side downstream slowness propagating to gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order logs and payment traces/metrics were excluded by context budget; the specific slow downstream (payment vs postgres) is not isolated.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s; traces show transport ReadTimeout on order and payment calls while inventory/redis succeed. Order p95 2387.5ms and 502s corroborate downstream latency. Payment/order logs excluded by budget, so exact slow dependency unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: order service logs to identify which downstream (payment/postgres) is slow
payment traces/metrics to confirm payment-side latency
postgres latency metrics for order save_order
